articles.title: Israel Expands Footprints in South Near Water Sources

articles.title: Unemployment, Poverty and Rising Prices: Syrians’ Top Concerns in a New Survey
articles.excerpt: Unemployment, poverty, the rising cost of services and price control remain among the main issues identified by participants, Shaam writes. The post Unemployment, Poverty and Rising Prices: Syrians’ Top Concerns in a New Survey first appeared on The Syrian Observer.
articles.summary: 据Shaam报道，一项新调查显示，失业、贫困、服务费用上涨和价格管控仍是叙利亚民众最关切的主要问题。

articles.title: Saudi Arabia Injects USD 403 Million into Syrian Projects… Why Are the Loans Concessional?

articles.title: Syria honors startups and entrepreneurs as it seeks to revive business sector
articles.summary: 叙利亚表彰本国初创企业与创业者，此举被视为叙政府推动商业部门复苏、重振民营经济努力的一部分。

articles.title: Hundreds Return as Syria Pushes to End Camps by 2027
articles.excerpt: Over three days, three voluntary return convoys supported 1,100 IDP Syrians return from 6 informal settlements in Deir-Ezzor to their communities. Facilitated…
articles.summary: 三天内三批自愿返回车队协助1100名叙利亚流离失所者，从代尔祖尔6个非正式安置点返回原社区。此举是叙政府推动在2027年前关闭流离失所者营地计划的一部分。

articles.title: Syria Disrupts ISIS Operations Amidst Ongoing Security Challenges

articles.title: Syria seeks Chinese investment in free zones amid reconstruction push
articles.summary: 叙利亚在推进重建进程的背景下，寻求吸引中国投资者进入其自由区（自贸区），以引入外资、扩大投资合作。

articles.title: Syria, France discuss cooperation on migration and refugee affairs
articles.summary: 叙利亚与法国就移民和难民事务的合作展开讨论，涉及双方在该领域的协调安排。

articles.summary: 叙利亚边防人员在黎巴嫩边境方向挫败一起毒品走私企图，未提及涉案人员与毒品数量细节。
